svg.text: Kiran Language Services · Order TRN-2207 · Delivered 4 October 2026 (synthetic sample)
Source: AirPure 300 user manual, English, 10 pages.
Translated pages in this file: 1 to 8 (Introduction, Safety, Setup, Controls, Filters, Modes, Cleaning, Troubleshooting).
Pages 9 and 10 (Maintenance schedule, Warranty) will follow in a separate file.
Layout: each translated page keeps the original page layout and figure positions.
Bilingual glossary of 50 key technical terms, English to Hindi, on the last page of this file.
Sample entries: filter = filter; air quality sensor = vayu gunvatta sensor; timer = samay-yantra.
Safety warnings are reproduced with their original formatting, as requested by the client.
